extracted.name: Easy Iced Coffee
extracted.description: You don't need to go to a coffee shop to get iced coffee—make this recipe at home for a fraction of the price! For the best flavor, start with chilled or room temperature coffee so that it doesn't melt the ice right away. (I like to use cooled hot coffee or cold brew—read more about these options in the blog post above!) Customize it with as much of your favorite milk and/or sweetener as you like.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup brewed coffee (chilled or at room temperature)
Sugar (simple syrup, or sweetener of choice, optional)
instruction_lines: Fill a glass with ice. Pour in the coffee and add milk as desired.
If desired, sweeten to taste with sugar, simple syrup, or another sweetener of your choice.
categories: how to make iced coffee at home
